task.title: Filter the Library
task.shortdesc: Combine schema, lifecycle, and validation filters to focus the saved profile list.

prereq.p: The Library is open and you know which profile state you need to inspect.

context.p: Filters are view controls. They do not change profile content, validation state, or lifecycle state.

step.cmd: Choose a Firefox schema channel filter when you need Release, ESR, or all profiles.

info.p: Expected result: the filtered count reflects only rows for the selected channel.

step.cmd: Choose a lifecycle filter to show active, archived, or all profiles.

info.p: Use archived when you are preparing to restore or permanently delete a retained profile.

step.cmd: Choose a validation filter to show passed, failed, or not-yet-validated profiles.

info.note: A validation filter does not run validation. It only shows the last saved validation state.

step.cmd: Reset filters to all states when you need the complete Library view.

info.p: This reset changes only the visible list, not the saved profile data.

result.p: The Library shows the profile subset that matches the selected schema, lifecycle, validation, and search criteria.

postreq.p: Recovery: if a profile seems missing, reset filters and search before treating it as absent.
